name: Talion
description: Talion, the Kindly Lord, is the Faerie Lord who sits on the throne of the Faerie realm and sends Kellan on a quest against three witches.

timeline.summary: Imodane stumbles through the woods into the throne room of the Faerie Lord, who says she was summoned and asks if she is pure of heart.

timeline.summary: Kellan meets Talion, who asks if he is true of heart and says he will answer questions in return for service.
timeline.quote: "Tell me, brave hero ... Are you true of heart?"

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Talion asks Kellan to defeat the three witches Agatha, Hylda and Eriette to break the Wicked Slumber in return for a boon.
timeline.quote: Whosoever is brave enough to defeat them shall break the curse upon the Realm

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart

timeline.summary: Kellan accepts the quest hoping to learn the truth about his father.

timeline.summary: Ruby agrees to guide Kellan to Dunbarrow in exchange for help finding her brother Peter, after he vaguely names his fae liege.
timeline.quote: "All right. I guess someone's got to look out for you, and it might as well be me."

timeline.summary: Peter helps carry the cauldron through a threshold to Talion's court, where Talion names Hylda as the next witch and the mirror Indrelon as the way to find her.
timeline.quote: "But consult the mirror Indrelon, and you may yet find her ."

timeline.summary: Lord Yorvo, apparently the Giant King, makes Kellan and his friends his guests and persuades Beluna to show them the mirror.
timeline.quote: "Consider you and yours my guests at this party."

timeline.quote: Talion was the one who broke the stalemate.
